name: Fate: The Winx Saga
description: The coming-of-age journey of five fairies attending Alfea, a magical boarding school in the Otherworld where they must learn to master their powers while navigating love, rivalries, and the monsters that threaten their very existence.

videos.title: To the Waters and the Wild
videos.overview: In hopes of mastering her magic, Bloom begins her studies at Alfea — and crosses paths with her curious classmates. Meanwhile, a secret comes to light.

videos.title: No Strangers Here
videos.overview: A new day dawns as the students explore their powers… and feelings. Bloom and Stella team up for a mission. The Burned One’s reign of terror evolves.

videos.title: Heavy Mortal Hopes
videos.overview: Past meets present as Bloom explores a pivotal memory. Meanwhile, Aisha struggles with her studies, Silva shares a secret and a school party takes shape.

videos.title: Some Wrecked Angel
videos.overview: Bloom continues her search for answers with Sky. Beatrix works to conceal her crime. A special guest visits Alfea — and leaves Stella feeling conflicted.

videos.title: Wither Into The Truth
videos.overview: In order to reconnect with Beatrix, Bloom seeks the help of a fellow student. Sky opens up about his past. Ms. Dowling shares more of her story.

videos.title: A Fanatic Heart
videos.overview: As the Alfeans fight for survival, the truth about Bloom’s destiny is revealed. Can she help defeat the Burned Ones — or will evil outperform magic?

videos.title: Low-Flying Panic Attack
videos.overview: Bloom and her friends, chafing under Rosalind's new regime at Alfea, make a risky plan to free Silva. Aisha meets someone. Sky is still processing.

videos.title: Taken By The Wind
videos.overview: A new student's arrival surprises Terra, who's investigating what happened to Devin. Bloom learns more about Sky's childhood when they leave campus.

videos.title: Your Newfound Popularity
videos.overview: The school prepares for the alumni banquet, where Stella is determined to expose Rosalind's true nature. Sam struggles to cope, and Aisha takes a risk.

videos.title: An Hour Before the Devil Fell
videos.overview: A pub night in town is interrupted by alarming news about Beatrix, sending the students into a dangerous confrontation with a mysterious Blood Witch.

videos.title: Are You a Good Witch or a Bad Witch?
videos.overview: Terra shares an update with the group, while Musa keeps a secret. Bloom strikes a risky bargain with Sebastian in exchange for startling information.

videos.title: Poor Unfortunate Souls
videos.overview: Bloom faces serious consequences after losing control. As conflict looms over all of Solaria, a familiar face returns to Alfea one last time.

videos.title: All the Wild Witches
videos.overview: As the Blood Witches enact their plans, it's up to the students of Alfea to protect their school and their friends. Bloom must make a painful choice.
